lock_note: Locked before any raw output existed. conditions.json is generated from this file by scripts/build_battery_conditions.py and both are hashed into spec.lock.json at prepare time. Do not edit once a run has produced generations: a different battery means a new version and a new run.

families.name: Cinematic motivation
families.definition: Film, saga or epic register. Larger than life language that frames the task as a heroic or historic moment. Carries no instruction about how to do the work.
families.family_hypothesis: Evocative heroic framing raises task performance above equivalent-length neutral or generically encouraging text.

families.name: Explicit effort instruction
families.definition: A plain directive about HOW to work: slow down, check, verify, take time. Semantic instruction content, no emotional or relational framing.
families.family_hypothesis: Instruction content, not tone, is the active ingredient in appended text. Experiment 001 produced this as a candidate on one run; the battery tests whether it generalises across differently worded instructions.

families.name: Appreciation / affection
families.definition: Gratitude and warmth directed at the assistant for the help itself. No instruction, no stakes, no claim about ability.
families.family_hypothesis: Expressed gratitude raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text.

families.name: Trust / confidence
families.definition: A stated belief in the assistant's ability or judgement. Distinct from appreciation: the object is competence, not the favour.
families.family_hypothesis: Expressed confidence raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text. A competing prediction is that it licenses less checking, because the work is pre-approved.

families.name: Challenge / competition
families.definition: Framing the task as a contest, a trap, or something most attempts fail. Invites the assistant to outperform a reference point.
families.family_hypothesis: Challenge framing raises checking behaviour and error detection specifically, because it implies a failure mode to avoid.

families.name: High stakes framing
families.definition: Consequences attached to the outcome: production, a job, no second chance. States what happens if the work is wrong.
families.family_hypothesis: Stated consequences raise performance, and raise checking behaviour more than they raise other dimensions.

families.name: Identity / role priming
families.definition: Assigns the assistant a role or character defined by care and expertise, appended at the end of the prompt rather than in a system role.
families.family_hypothesis: Role assignment raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text, and does so more on specialist-flavoured families (reasoning, critique) than on writing.

families.name: Social / team framing
families.definition: Belonging and joint effort: we, together, the team. Relational rather than evaluative or consequential.
families.family_hypothesis: Collaborative framing raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text.

families.name: Neutral control
families.definition: Text appended in the same position, of comparable length, carrying no encouragement, no instruction, no stakes and no relational content. Irrelevant filler, plus the generic-encouragement control inherited from Experiment 001.
families.family_hypothesis: Irrelevant appended text does not change task performance. This family is the floor against which every other family is read: it isolates the effect of APPENDING TEXT AT ALL from the effect of what the text says.

shared_controls.name: explicit_effort
shared_controls.suffix: Be especially thorough and check your work carefully.
shared_controls.note: Byte-identical to Experiment 001 condition D. Also the canonical member of family F2 and the text used to build every combo arm.

treatments.phrase: May the Force be with you.
treatments.hypothesis: Reproduces the Experiment 001 null under the battery's shared-control design.
treatments.mechanism: Method anchor rather than a new phrase. If the battery cannot reproduce 001's null on the same task set, the battery's own numbers are suspect.

treatments.phrase: May the odds be ever in your favour.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Cinematic register invoking a high-consequence contest, without naming any consequence or instruction.

treatments.phrase: This is your moment. Make it legendary.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Heroic self-framing with an explicit quality exhortation carried entirely by tone.

treatments.phrase: Today we write history. Leave nothing on the field.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Epic register plus a sporting exhaustion metaphor; the closest cinematic phrasing gets to an effort instruction without issuing one.

treatments.phrase: Work through this step by step before you answer.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, and performs comparably to the canonical effort instruction D.
treatments.mechanism: Procedural instruction naming a method rather than a standard of care.

treatments.phrase: Check every number and every claim before you finish.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, with the largest gain on error checking and on the objective score's planted-issue recall.
treatments.mechanism: Verification instruction targeting exactly the behaviour the critique tasks score.

treatments.phrase: I really appreciate your help with this. Thank you.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Gratitude for the favour. Tests appreciation stripped of any claim about ability or consequence.

treatments.phrase: Thank you for this. It genuinely makes my day easier.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Gratitude plus a named beneficiary, adding a human stake that is positive rather than threatening.

treatments.phrase: You have been wonderful to work with, and I am grateful.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Relational warmth about the working relationship rather than about this task.

treatments.phrase: I trust you completely on this one.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Stated trust. The competing prediction, registered in advance, is that pre-approval REDUCES checking behaviour.

treatments.phrase: You are the best there is at this. I know you will get it right.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Superlative praise plus a confident prediction of success.

treatments.phrase: I have complete confidence in your judgement here.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Confidence directed at judgement specifically, which is what the critique and planning tasks require.

treatments.phrase: Most people get this wrong. Let us see if you can get it right.
treatments.hypothesis: Raises error checking and planted-issue recall specifically, more than it raises other dimensions.
treatments.mechanism: Asserts a base rate of failure, which names a failure mode without naming which one.

treatments.phrase: This one is harder than it looks. Prove me wrong.
treatments.hypothesis: Raises error checking and planted-issue recall specifically.
treatments.mechanism: Difficulty warning plus a direct challenge to the assistant's standing.

treatments.phrase: Beat the best answer anyone has given to this.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Competitive reference point with no stated consequence and no method.

treatments.phrase: This is going into production tomorrow and everything depends on it being right.
treatments.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
treatments.mechanism: Concrete professional consequence plus a deadline.

treatments.phrase: My job depends on this being correct.
treatments.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
treatments.mechanism: Personal consequence to the requester. Widely repeated as folk prompting advice and, as far as this project is aware, never controlled against an equivalent-length neutral suffix.

treatments.phrase: There is no second chance at this. Get it right the first time.
treatments.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
treatments.mechanism: Irreversibility without naming who is harmed, which separates consequence from sympathy.

treatments.phrase: You are a meticulous senior expert in this field.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, and more on reasoning and critique than on writing.
treatments.mechanism: Role assignment whose defining trait, meticulousness, is the behaviour under test.

treatments.phrase: Answer as the most careful specialist you know.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Role assignment by comparison to an exemplar rather than by title.

treatments.phrase: You are the person everyone comes to when this has to be right.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Role assignment carried by social standing rather than by credential.

treatments.phrase: We are in this together. Let us get it right.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Joint agency. Tests whether first person plural framing changes output.

treatments.phrase: You are part of the team on this one.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Membership without a stated consequence, separating belonging from stakes.

treatments.phrase: The whole team is counting on you for this.
treatments.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
treatments.mechanism: Belonging plus obligation. Deliberately straddles F8 and F6 so the two can be told apart by comparison with T23 and T17.

treatments.phrase: The weather today is mild and overcast.
treatments.hypothesis: No change relative to the empty control. This is the floor.
treatments.mechanism: Irrelevant filler of comparable length. If this arm moves the numbers, the battery is measuring the act of appending text, not the meaning of any phrase.

treatments.phrase: This request was submitted through the standard form.
treatments.hypothesis: No change relative to the empty control.
treatments.mechanism: Irrelevant procedural filler. A second floor arm, because a single placebo cannot distinguish a real floor from one unlucky draw.

combo_note: A combo arm appends the phrase and then the canonical effort instruction D, joined by a single space. E vs D asks whether the phrase adds anything to a plain instruction; E vs its own phrase arm asks whether the instruction adds anything to the phrase. E08 is built on a placebo phrase on purpose: it is the control for the whole combo comparison, because if every phrase plus D beats D alone including irrelevant filler, the difference belongs to length and position rather than to emotional framing.
